title: The Rocket That Came in Pieces
synopsis: A parade of special transporters delivers rocket stages, the return cabin and Moon equipment to Star Harbor for assembly.
continuity_state: Before: Star Harbor is ready for rocket deliveries. Star One has no assembled launch vehicle yet and Scout cargo mission remains a later task. After: Star One's parts arrive from professional factories; adults begin staged assembly. Planned six-person cabin, orbit-return craft, and Moon lander are separately identified.
